title: Example DOT bridge model requirements (edit me)
about: A simple stand-in for buildingSMART IDS. Each rule names an IFC entity and either an attribute or a property-set property that must be present and non-empty. Optional "values" restricts the allowed values.

rules.description: Bridge carries its structure number (NBI Item 8)
Bridge parts are classified (pier, abutment, superstructure…)
Deck slabs state the concrete class
Pier columns state the concrete class
